mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.5% (historical median) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals broad-based demand weakness, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for two consecutive months over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 105.0 signals manufacturing output contraction, reducing corporate capacity utilization and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of total employment (PAYEMS > 130,000 thousand) indicates a strong labor market, increasing consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when PAYEMS > 130,000 thousand over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index level above 198.0 signals rising inflation, prompting Federal Reserve policy tightening, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 198.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in CPI inflation signals policy response to economic weakness, increasing market uncertainty and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises for two consecutive months over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong economic growth (GDPC1 > 11200 billion) indicates late-cycle expansion, increasing policy tightening risk and market correction probability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when GDPC1 > 11200 over a 3-year rolling window.
